keySentence: She walked through the forest to visit Grandmother.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She had to visit Grandmother. The forest was long. She was brave and strong. She walked through the forest to visit Grandmother.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Red Riding Hood was deep inside the forest now. She saw pretty flowers but remembered Mother's warning. She walked through the forest to visit Grandmother without stopping. She held her basket of bread and fruit tightly. The path was long but she thought of Grandmother's smile. She was brave enough to walk the whole way alone.
